name: request-response-reply
description: exchange-pattern=request-response: when a consumer of sales_queue replies, the reply body becomes the flow result and so the HTTP response body.

source.reference: sending-json-data-to-a-amqp-queue/src/main/app/json-to-rabbitmq.xml (amqp:outbound-endpoint exchange-pattern=request-response is the last processor; its response is the flow result returned by http:listener)
